items.name: OffsetConfig
items.comment: The global layer of the three-layer offset (global + meta + temp).

fields.name: global
fields.comment: Offset in milliseconds applied to every song.

fields.name: useMeta
fields.comment: Whether the lyric's own meta offset is applied on top of the global one.

fields.name: resetTempOnLyricChange
fields.comment: Whether the temporary offset is cleared when a new lyric loads.

fields.name: bridgeActive
fields.comment: Whether gaps in the active-line indices are filled so the active range stays contiguous.

fields.name: mergeWindow
fields.comment: Window in milliseconds within which consecutive lines cluster and deactivate together.

fields.name: mergeLimit
fields.comment: Maximum number of lines in one merge batch; a value of 0 or less leaves it unbounded.

fields.name: offset
fields.comment: Global layer of the three-layer lyric offset.
